policy: All application UI uses authentic source pixels. Crops, resizing and WebP encoding are deterministic. No UI has been generated or redrawn. Original img/ files are untouched. New atmospheric backplates are separately generated and documented in artwork/provenance.json.
homepageArtwork: artwork/compositions.json maps all eight live layered compositions and their raster exports to the unchanged UI sources.
hero: The exact user-supplied Light Sculpture is preserved at assets/hero/light-sculpture-source.png and optimized to light-sculpture.webp. No generated replacement.
compositions: product-composition-{640,1200}.webp and product-composition-master.png are browser exports of the real screenshot/CSS scenes. The live homepage uses responsive screenshot layers rather than flattened posters so parallax remains independent.
